summary: Agent Builder v0.4.1 is accepted but untagged. The author closed the amended v0.5.0 Build and opened Review. The candidate passed 79 tests on Python 3.9 and 3.14, render, pinned bundle, and Ruff checks. Real-use acceptance is open; v0.5.0 is not accepted or tagged. The full decision history is in governance/decisions.yaml.

decisions.summary: Adapt existing guidance and templates for lean, behavior-tested cycles; offer optional independent review only for very large changes.
Return v0.5.0 from Review to Plan to scope cleanup.
Retire four historical files with Git-history retrieval and compact this handoff.
Design behavior tests in Plan, keep one-off probes uncommitted, test continuing guarantees, and use test-to-code size as a review signal.
Close Plan and reopen Build for the approved amendments.
Close the amended Build, open Review, commit the phase records, and push main without accepting or tagging v0.5.0.

next_action: Assess the amended candidate on a real project using the three Review scenarios. Offer one optional independent review of this 47-path cycle; do not run it automatically. Acceptance and tagging remain separate decisions.
